description: Generic DynamicOut fan-out AS AN ASSET: discover → map → collect.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Optional Dagster asset key to load and pass into the discover callable as `upstream=<value>`. When None, discover fetches its items from its own source (URL list, filesystem, queue, etc.).

discover_callable_path.label: Discover Callable Path
discover_callable_path.description: 'module:function' that returns an iterable of items. Signature: discover(upstream=<loaded>, **discover_kwargs) → List[item]. The upstream kwarg is only passed when upstream_asset_key is set.

process_callable_path.label: Process Callable Path
process_callable_path.description: 'module:function' that takes one item and returns a result. Signature: process(item, **process_kwargs).

process_kwargs.label: Process Kwargs
process_kwargs.description: Static kwargs merged into each process call.

collect_callable_path.label: Collect Callable Path
collect_callable_path.description: Optional 'module:function' that takes the list of process results and returns the asset's final value. If omitted, the asset materializes as the raw list of process results.

mapping_key_field.label: Mapping Key Field
mapping_key_field.description: If items are dicts, use this field as the DynamicOutput mapping_key so per-item retries are stable across runs. None → the loop index is used (stable within a run, not across).

max_concurrent_tag_value.label: Max Concurrent Tag Value
max_concurrent_tag_value.description: If set, applies `dagster/concurrency_key=<value>` to the process op so an instance-level concurrency limit governs fan-out parallelism.

fail_on_empty.label: Fail On Empty
fail_on_empty.description: Fail the graph if discover returns no items.
